config.max_carry_forward_age_rationale: Fixed maximum age of 3600s; the largest observed equity snapshot gap in the archive is 11940s, so a compliant carry-forward cannot cover the full window and the cross-account comparison is reported as NOT_COMPARABLE instead of being fabricated.

cross_symbol_exposure.netting_note: Gross entry notional only; opposite-side positions and cross-symbol notionals are never netted.

provenance.independence_caveat: A cluster is a dependence group, not a set of independent observations.
limitations: Single bounded 24h forward-paper export; not a statistical sample.
Manifest declares BOUNDED_BEST_EFFORT_NOT_REPEATABLE_READ and mutable position snapshots.
No prospective shadow history: results are descriptive, never a profitability claim.
